about: Night Market's gate (night-market-remaster RM9, art/grid/round-68-night-market-gate): Hunyuan3D 2.1 from ref-gate.jpg (r7's three-bay gate), picked over TRELLIS.2 at the shipped budget (TRELLIS's gold trim and plinths went dark in the 15k re-bake). The take comes out upside down (--up x180). Near 12k triangles (the plaza tiles' pinned resident rows hold it with ~100 KB each to spare; 15k overran them by up to 118 KB) and far 2.5k, both on one 1024 WebP atlas and no normal map; layouts/night-market.json scales it to its height.
